Book correction: The book prints 2\cos 2\theta = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}. This is a misprint: each square root halves the angle (4\theta \to 2\theta \to \theta), so the right side equals 2\cos\theta. At \theta = 30^{\circ} the printed left side is 1 but the right side is \sqrt{3}. The correct statement is 2\cos\theta = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}} (for 0 \le \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}).
